REMOVAL SERVICE POINTS
<<A>> HARNESS CONNECTOR REMOVAL
Removal the grommet Tie a cord to the end of the harness 
connector, wind plastic tape around it so that there is no other 
side.
INSTALLATION SERVICE POINTS
>>A<< HARNESS CONNECTOR INSTALLATION
1. Tie the cord that was used during removal to the end of the 
harness connector, wind plastic tape around it so that there 
is no unevenness.
2. Pull the cord to pull through the harness connector.
3. Install the grommet.
>>B<< TRUNK LID OPENING WEATHERSTRIP 
INSTALLATION
Install the trunk lid opening weatherstrip so that its marking is 
positioned at the center of the vehicle.
